result.instructions: Tools for PlanetScale, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the databases in our organization and show which branches are production."; "Show the open deploy requests for the orders database and what they change."; "Create a branch called add-invoice-index from main and open a deploy request for it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PlanetScale data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run planetscale_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run planetscale_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run planetscale_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. planetscale_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: planetscale_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the service token can see. Start here to find the organization name. GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: planetscale_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Get one organization: name, plan and settings. GET /v1/organizations/{organization}.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

tools.name: planetscale_list_public_regions
tools.title: List public regions
tools.description: List the PlanetScale regions and their cloud providers. Public endpoint: GET /v1/regions.

tools.name: planetscale_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the databases in an organization, with their state and kind (Postgres or MySQL). GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/databases.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

kind.description: Filter by database kind, for example postgresql or vitess.

tools.name: planetscale_get_database
tools.title: Get a database
tools.description: Get one database: state, default branch, regions and settings. GET /v1/organizations/{organization}/databases/{database}.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

tools.name: planetscale_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the branches of a database, with ready state and whether each is a production branch. GET .../databases/{database}/branches.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

production.description: Only production (true) or only development (false) branches.

tools.name: planetscale_get_branch
tools.title: Get a branch
tools.description: Get one branch: ready state, parent branch, region and access host. GET .../branches/{branch}.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

tools.name: planetscale_get_branch_schema
tools.title: Get a branch schema
tools.description: Get the CREATE statements (schema only, no table data) of a branch. GET .../branches/{branch}/schema.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

tools.name: planetscale_list_branch_backups
tools.title: List branch backups
tools.description: List the backups of a branch, with state and time. GET .../branches/{branch}/backups.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

state.description: Filter by backup state, for example success.

from.description: Only backups created after this ISO 8601 time.

to.description: Only backups created before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: planetscale_list_deploy_requests
tools.title: List deploy requests
tools.description: List schema change deploy requests of a database, with state and branches. GET .../deploy-requests.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

state.description: Filter by state, for example open, closed or merged.

tools.name: planetscale_get_deploy_request
tools.title: Get a deploy request
tools.description: Get one deploy request by its number: state, diff summary and deployment status. GET .../deploy-requests/{number}.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

tools.name: planetscale_create_branch
tools.title: Create a branch
tools.description: Create a development branch from a parent branch (default main). Creates billable resources; it does not change production. POST .../branches.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

parent_branch.description: Parent branch to copy the schema from (default main).

tools.name: planetscale_create_deploy_request
tools.title: Create a deploy request
tools.description: Open a deploy request that merges schema changes from a branch into another branch. Opening it does not deploy; a person must review and deploy it. POST .../deploy-requests.

organization.description: Organization name (the slug in the PlanetScale URL).

branch.description: Source branch with the schema changes.

notes.description: Notes shown on the deploy request.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with PlanetScale
prompts.description: What you can do with PlanetScale here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_databases_and_their_branches
prompts.title: See databases and their branches
prompts.description: List the organizations, then the databases of one. Read a database's state, default branch and regions, and list its branches.

prompts.name: read_a_branch_schema_and_its_backups
prompts.title: Read a branch schema and its backups
prompts.description: Read the CREATE statements of a branch, without table data. List the backups of a branch with their state and time.

prompts.name: review_open_deploy_requests
prompts.title: Review open deploy requests
prompts.description: List the schema change deploy requests of a database. Open one to read its state, diff summary and deployment status.

prompts.name: create_a_development_branch
prompts.title: Create a development branch
prompts.description: Create a development branch from a parent branch, main by default. The branch uses billable resources, and production does not change.

prompts.name: open_a_deploy_request_for_review
prompts.title: Open a deploy request for review
prompts.description: Open a deploy request that merges schema changes from one branch into another. A person still reviews and deploys it.

prompts.name: list_regions_and_branch_details
prompts.title: List regions and branch details
prompts.description: List the public regions with their cloud providers. Read one branch's ready state, parent branch and region.
